lede: Danville wraps Christmas around its historic courthouse square, then moves to Ellis Park for Santaland and a drive-through light show.
celebrates: Danville kicks off the season on the Friday after Thanksgiving with Christmas on the Square, when the streets around the historic Hendricks County Courthouse close to traffic and the storefronts, shops and restaurants glow with lights. Santa helps light the community tree at 6:30 pm, kids can mail letters to the North Pole, and Christmas music and caroling fill the square. Ellis Park carries the season forward with Santaland at the train station and the Winterland Holiday Light Show. Beasley's Orchard offers Santa photos, and Clippers Barbershop turns a Saturday into cookies and Santa for kids.
lastyear: Visit Hendricks County promoted the 2025 Christmas on the Square for Friday, November 28, 2025, with a save-the-date video that pitched small-town Christmas, a tree lighting, Santa and a holiday market. The tourism bureau's photo of the Danville tree lighting dates from 2022, which shows the square has been doing the same evening for years. In 2026 the event returns on the same Friday after Thanksgiving, with the tree lighting again at 6:30 pm.
facts: Christmas on the Square is described by Visit Hendricks County as a tradition that for years has brought families, friends and neighbors together to start the season in downtown Danville. The courthouse that anchors the square is the historic Hendricks County Courthouse, and the lights stretch across the whole square. Kids can write a letter to Santa and drop it into a special mailbox headed to the North Pole. Parking is free on the side streets while the square is closed to traffic.
trains: Danville does not have a Christmas train, though Santaland at Ellis Park is held at the park's train station. Our guide has no train ride in Hendricks County, so the closest listing is Nickel Plate Express in Forest Park in Noblesville, on the north side of the Indianapolis area. It runs trains in the Christmas season, including the Reindeer Express. Check that page for dates and tickets before you plan a drive, because train seats sell out early.

faq: When is Christmas on the Square in Danville in 2026?

Christmas on the Square is Friday, November 27, 2026, from 4 to 7 pm in downtown Danville. It is free. Santa helps light the community Christmas tree at 6:30 pm, and the square is closed to traffic, with free public parking on the side streets. Bring warm layers because most of the fun is outdoors.
Where is the Danville Christmas tree lighting?

The tree lighting is on the Danville Courthouse Square, around the historic Hendricks County Courthouse in downtown Danville. The lights stretch across the square, and the shops and restaurants around it stay open. Because the square is closed to traffic that evening, plan to park on a side street and walk in.
What is Winterland at Ellis Park?

Winterland is a holiday light show at Ellis Park in Danville that you drive through. The 2026 listing shows $5 per vehicle Monday to Thursday and $10 per vehicle Friday to Sunday. It is open most nights from 6 pm, and the card on this page lists the hours and the nights it is closed.
Where can kids meet Santa in Danville?

Santa is at Christmas on the Square on November 27, at Santaland at Ellis Park on weekend evenings from November 28 to December 20, at Beasley's Orchard on Saturday photo days, and at Cookies and Cuts at Clippers Barbershop on December 19. Each card lists its own time, cost and link.
Is there a Christmas train in Danville?

Danville has no Christmas train ride. Santaland is held at the Ellis Park train station, so kids get the depot setting without a ride. The closest train in our guide is Nickel Plate Express in Noblesville, which runs the Reindeer Express in the Christmas season and sells tickets ahead of time.
